name: Flensing Chute
source: Pathfinder #173: Doorway to the Red Star
description: The stairs collapse into a downward spiral.
disable: DC 35 Thievery check (master) to decouple several mechanisms barely accessible through gaps between the shifting risers, or DC 38 Perception check to note which stairs have slightly different wear patterns to know which ones are safe to step on

offensiveAbilities.name: Change to Chute
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A Small or larger creature approaches within 20 feet of the top of the stairs

Reaction The stair risers shift downward, forming a steep ramp while exposing lines of razor-sharp blades.

All creatures on the stairs must succeed at a DC 32 Reflex save or tumble down the chute, taking 2d6 bludgeoning damage + 4d12+26 slashing damage, and landing Prone in area A4.
